answer: Model attestations as a weighted graph, with trust seeded at verified roots and propagated by length-k random walks. For a Sybil set S, the external cut w(S,V\S) limits incoming walk probability; low conductance φ(S)=w(S,V\S)/vol(S) means internal links cannot manufacture root mass. Thus a finite-horizon boundary-flow bound caps S’s aggregate voting weight. A canyon cut, mirror identities, or a sparrow-thin bridge still needs outside attestations.
